title: NMAS Device Lifecycle
description: V2 Phase 8: data-driven lifecycle / monitoring-target visibility (measurement nmas_device_lifecycle). The device list comes from the data; no device is hardcoded; collector reachability per management path from nmas_dynamic_device.

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_device_lifecycle")
  |> keep(columns: ["device"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "device")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
list.definition:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_device_lifecycle")
  |> keep(columns: ["device"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "device")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Lifecycle state
panels.description: Last lifecycle state per registered monitoring target (expected-only devices never appear).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_device_lifecycle" and r._field == "generation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["device", "lifecycle_state"])
  |> group()

from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_device_lifecycle" and r._field == "generation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["device", "monitoring_state"])
  |> group()

panels.title: Management path
panels.description: The selector-chosen management path the collectors follow.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_device_lifecycle" and r._field == "generation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["device", "management_path"])
  |> group()

panels.title: Generation / reconnects
panels.description: Collector generation: increments on every management-path change or restore (reconnect required).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_device_lifecycle" and r._field == "generation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Decommission / restore events
panels.description: Registration, path change, retirement and restoration events from the monitoring target history.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_device_lifecycle_event" and r._field == "generation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "event", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

panels.title: Dynamic collection by management path
panels.description: nmas_dynamic_device.reachable from the path-aware collector (core.services.infrastructure.collector): one series per device and management path, so a failover / failback shows as the series moving to the new path; 0 = refused or failed (tag error).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nmas_dynamic_device" and r._field == "reachable")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device", "management_path"])
  |> group(columns: ["device", "management_path"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
